refnamediv.refpurpose: Calculates the derivatives of an image

listitem.para: Input image (single channel 8-bit, or 32-bit if mode is CV_RETR_CCOMP or CV_RETR_FLOODFILL) (Mat).

itemizedlist.member: CV_RETR_EXTERNAL: returns only the outer contours.
CV_CCOMP: returns a two level hierarchy in which the top level contains the outer boundaries of components, and the second level contains the holes.
CV_RETR_TREE: returns full hierarchy of contours.
CV_CHAIN_APPROX_ONE: stores all the contour points.
CV_RETR_LIST: stores only end points of (horizontal/vertical/diagonal) segments.
CV_CHAIN_APPROX_TC89_L1, CV_CHAIN_APPROX_TC89_KCOS: used the the Tech-Chin algorithm to store points.

listitem.para: Optional offset by which every contour point is shifted (default [0, 0]).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: findContours retrieves the contours from a binary image.
